'''Rialla Way''' was a location in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Livien Magnus]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Radama/Legends|Ord Radama]]. Sometime between [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]] and [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] it was [[Bombing of Rialla Way|bombarded]] per the orders of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Malau Jocaos]] as a means of blaming the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|rebels]] and turning [[Var Narek]] into an Imperial [[Spy/Legends|spy]].<ref name="Onslaught at Arda I">''[[Onslaught at Arda I]]''</ref>
